messages:
sara: heads-up: received a user report that embeddings calls are returning results post-key-rotation even though the new token should be scoped to 'chat' only. attaching logs below.

ajay: can you paste the exact request headers and the rotation event id?

sara: rotation id `rekey-2026-03-19-11`
sara: request log snippet: `INFO request_id=rx-9a3 auth_token=tok-xyz scope=chat route=/v1/embeddings model=embed-small status=200 latency_ms=42`

max: whoa the auth_token shows scope=chat but runtime still allowed embeddings. that suggests scope eval returned wrong effective scope, or route-level enforcement was bypassed. any recent changes to scope caching?

tess: incident-bot: new alert created (#INC-2026-58) - suspected authz regression affecting embeddings routes.

sara: there's a related KMS rewrap job that removed a custom tag we use to mark tokens as 'permitted_embeddings' during rotate. possible metadata loss.

ajay: if KMS metadata is the source of truth for route allowlists, losing that tag could cause a fallback. check code path: `authz.evaluate_token_scope()` -> if token metadata not found -> fallback to `legacy_allowlist_check()` which historically was permissive for embeddings.

max: past incidents showed fallback behavior was overly liberal. we had an explicit decision to deny-by-default but the fallback predates that.

ajay: reproducing locally: I rotated a test key via kms-rewrap CLI and saw `metadata.tags` cleared for tokens created by the rotate job. then `authz` logs show `metadata_missing=true effective_scope=chat fallback=legacy_check allowed_routes=[/v1/chat/*]` -> legacy_check returned true for `/v1/embeddings` because of a regex bug.

sara: attaching the problematic regex: `^/v1/(chat|text|.*embeds)` (oops).

tess: immediate mitigation: rate-limit embeddings for rotated tokens and add a temporary filter that rejects embeddings requests where token.was_rotated=true and token.scope != embeddings. can we patch gateway before end of day?

ajay: yes I can push a short-circuit rule in the API gateway (nginx/lua) to enforce explicit route->scope mapping while we fix runtime. patch will log `audit.effective_scope` and `audit.checkpoint=gateway` for later forensics.

max: long term fixes: 1) change fallback to deny-by-default 2) ensure KMS rewrap preserves token metadata tags or we persist tags in authz DB during rotate 3) add unit tests for route regexes 4) add an audit field `effective_scope` persisted in request events and in KMS rotation logs.

sara: agree. also let's add a small smoke test that runs after rotate jobs: call both chat and embeddings with the rotated token and assert only allowed routes succeed. put that in the rewrap pipeline.

tess: I'll own the rollback/runbook: if we see >0.1% of embeddings coming from rotated tokens, we will automatically roll back the rewrap job and re-add the tag. I will also create a PagerDuty alert.

ajay: PR plan: (1) gateway short-circuit today (ajay) (2) runtime fallback change + tests (max) (3) KMS rewrap job fix to copy tags (sara) (4) add smoke test to rewrap pipeline (max) (5) add audit fields to logs + 30d retention (tess).

sara: timeline sounds good. I'll take 1st postmortem note and record evidence for compliance audit. we need to show detection and mitigation steps for customers.

kms-bot: kms-rewrap-job `rekey-2026-03-19-11` status=completed affected_tokens=312 rewrap_time=2026-03-19T11:03:12Z

ajay: small code snippet I'll deploy to gateway: `if token.metadata_missing or token.scope_mismatch then return 403 else continue` will also emit `X-Authz-Effective-Scope` header for tracing.

max: attention to logs: add structured `authz.event` fields: `event_type` (auth_check), `effective_scope`, `policy_source` (gateway/runtime/kms-db), `rotation_id` if present. that'll make post-incident analytics easier.

sara: will follow up with compliance on the audit trail content they require. thanks all. :thumbsup:
